problem_statement: Reject malformed non-CRLF chunk footers while continuing to accept ordinary chunked bodies and CRLF footers fragmented across receive calls.
notes: The reference patch is the upstream implementation change under the MIT license in LICENSE.upstream.
The original MIT-licensed evaluation oracle uses tiny in-memory HTTP messages; it starts no proxy or server.
The advisory merge 114803a29ce50116dc47951c690ad4892b1a36ed resolves to the selected ordinary fix commit; exact lineage is used rather than ambiguous patched-version prose.
Only h11/tests/test_io.py and the external oracle are selected; request chaining, deployed proxies and complete parser coverage are outside this case.
